validations.message: Pods must not use the host network.
Pods must not use the host PID namespace.
Pods must not use the host IPC namespace.

validations.expression: !has(object.spec.volumes) || object.spec.volumes.all(v, !has(v.hostPath) || ((v.hostPath.path == '/var/lib/canaverald' && has(v.hostPath.type) && v.hostPath.type == 'Directory') || (v.hostPath.path == '/var/run/libvirt/libvirt-sock' && has(v.hostPath.type) && v.hostPath.type == 'Socket') || (v.hostPath.path == '/var/lib/libvirt/images/canaveral' && has(v.hostPath.type) && v.hostPath.type == 'Directory')))
validations.message: hostPath volumes are limited to the canaverald state directory, the libvirt socket and VM storage with their exact types.
Containers must set allowPrivilegeEscalation to false.

validations.expression: object.spec.containers.all(c, has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities.drop) && c.securityContext.capabilities.drop.exists(d, d == 'ALL') && (!has(c.securityContext.capabilities.add) || size(c.securityContext.capabilities.add) == 0))
validations.message: Containers must drop ALL capabilities and add none.
Containers must not use host ports.
Init containers must not be privileged.
Init containers must set allowPrivilegeEscalation to false.

validations.expression: !has(object.spec.initContainers) || object.spec.initContainers.all(c, has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities.drop) && c.securityContext.capabilities.drop.exists(d, d == 'ALL') && (!has(c.securityContext.capabilities.add) || size(c.securityContext.capabilities.add) == 0))
validations.message: Init containers must drop ALL capabilities and add none.
